name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 9 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 25 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 2.15 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
